name: Saikai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Saikai city emblem in blue: a disc bearing a diagonal row of white ovals.
history: Municipal flag of Saikai, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 2005.

features.role: Saikai city emblem — a disc bearing a diagonal row of white ovals
